chunks: And I bear witness that there is no god but Allah,
He is One, there is no partner with Him: He is the First, such that nothing was before Him, and the Last, such that there is no limit for Him,
Imagination cannot catch any of His qualities, and hearts cannot entertain belief about His nature,
Analysis and division cannot be applied to Him, and eyes and hearts cannot encompass Him.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is the First and the Last beyond human imagination?
ai.summary: This passage from Nahj al-Balagha articulates the Shia doctrine of Tawhid al-Sifat, emphasizing God's transcendence (Tanzih) by negating spatial, temporal, and qualitative limitations. It reflects the theological consensus that while God is the First (Al-Awwal) and Last (Al-Akhir), His essence remains beyond the grasp of human intellect (Aql) and senses (Basar), a concept central to distinguishing divine unity from anthropomorphism.

en.sayed-ali-raza: I stand witness that there is no god but Allāh,
He is One and there is no partner with Him. He is the First, such that nothing was before Him. He is the Last, such that there is not limit for Him.
Imagination cannot catch any of His qualities. Hearts cannot entertain belief about His nature.
Analysis and division cannot be applied to Him. Eyes and hearts cannot encompass Him.
